notes:
How was Quattro created? It all began with a number — four. A symbol of balance, direction, and structure. In Spanish, it’s "cuatro" simple, almost ordinary. So we reimagined it as Quattro, a word that feels global, refined, and timeless. It became more than a name; it became our philosophy. A belief that every brand deserves clarity, intention, and design that moves with purpose.

Designer: @keilethh. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
